quotes.text:
SECCIÓN H HORAS TRABAJADAS

       Todas las preguntas de la sección se reﬁeren a la actividad principal, excepto donde se indica.

assessments.reasoning: The survey instrument records time spent exclusively on paid economic activities in Section H (Horas trabajadas), asking for hours worked per week in the main activity (h3a) and secondary activity (h3b). It does not collect data on time allocation or hours spent across non-market or daily activities such as unpaid domestic work, unpaid care, or leisure. Consequently, the questionnaire does not ask how respondents allocate or spend their time across daily activities.
